original_reviewed_module_archive.reason: Exact original source bytes preserved in JSON; raw source ended in a blank line that Git whitespace checks refuse as a new file.

scope: Two fixed distinct reviewers each made one fresh whole-batch web source review. Their original reports and own request/catalog provenance remain separate and immutable; matching body hashes do not replace fresh access. Earlier author captures are historical provenance, not reviewer fresh sources.
secondary_scope: Each report/catalog binds its own fresh secondary source captures or explicitly attributed web-tool observations. Failed accesses do not support claims. Compact extracted HTML text retains original response hash without claiming full raw secondary HTML bytes were saved.
review_timing_scope: Per-item author and formal-review intervals are distinct and recorded exactly. No time or budget claim is inferred from receipts.
original_to_retained_path_scope: Original immutable reports may name temporary paths. This manifest binds preserved evidence under the single bounded review setup; only duplicate staging is removed after hash verification.
